Commits: `406924eb08`, `00feb901c6`, `c9dba22ddc`. Both authored files match ledger HEAD; no authored source changes remain uncommitted.

**Epistemic checkpoint:** proved producer. Frontier: `AJC.picrep.divzero` open → closed. Consumer: the actual degree-zero `RepresentableBy` construction. Both narrow module builds passed, and transitive axiom checks report only `propext`, `Classical.choice`, and `Quot.sound`. **Honesty-reviewer: used; approved.** The source attribution explicitly identifies this as a degree-zero companion to Kleiman’s positive-degree statement.

## Issues

`fgaPicardRepresentability` remains unchanged and sorry-backed. Existing dependency and graph warnings were recorded. New modules remain standalone; no umbrella build was run because umbrella imports were unchanged.

Pre-existing uncommitted changes remain in `DivGrassmannianH1.lean`, `PicEtPointedReduction.lean`, and the restructuring under `blueprint/src/`. These were neither modified nor committed by this session. Graph and Horizon control-plane updates are excluded from the ledger.

Janitor review archived three resolved conversations; remaining collection warnings concern ongoing work.

## Why I stopped

The task is partly advanced and remains running. Degree-zero representability is proved, while positive-degree native generation and the PicEt representing scheme still require substantive constructions.

## Next

Continue `AJC.picrep.divgrassmannian.native-generation`: construct locally invertible section maps, connect general Cartier family kernels to divisor modules, and prove epimorphy of the kernel adjunction counit.
